card.name: Linking words before active metabolite
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, a, its, and) right before the phrase 'active metabolite', usually in statements that one drug is the metabolite of another. Also seen after 'inspected' before 'chips or cracks'.

modes.label: Metabolite relationship
modes.description: A short word like the, a or its comes just before 'major active metabolite' or 'metabolite of' another drug.
modes.example: Since paliperidone is<< the>> major active metabolite of risperid

modes.label: Drug and its metabolite
modes.description: A joining word after a drug name leads into 'its active metabolite' in interaction text.
modes.example: increased the AUC of aripiprazole<< and>> its active metabolite by

modes.label: Tablet inspection
modes.description: The word 'for' after 'inspected' in tablet handling instructions.
modes.example: Tegretol-XR tablets should be inspected<< for>> chips or cracks.
